questions.question: Who is introduced in chapter 7 as a scribe skilled in the Law of Moses?
Why did the good hand of God rest on Ezra?
options: He commanded a great, well-trained, and well-disciplined army
He came from a noble, ancient, and highly honored family
He had gathered to himself great wealth while in Babylon
He set his heart to study, do, and teach the Law of the LORD
questions.answer: He set his heart to study, do, and teach the Law of the LORD
